Definition: irregular superlative of G4183; the largest number or very large:--very great, most.
BiblicalUsage: Pleistos means the most, the very great multitude. A very great multitude spread their garments in the way in Matthew 21:8, and a great multitude gathered to hear Jesus by the sea in Mark 4:1. But Matthew 11:20 says the cities where most of His mighty works were done repented not.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the greatest crowds can still refuse Him — numbers never proved faith.
